name: Devil's blessing
source:
One day, right before Christmas...
A shady guy shows up out of nowhere and tells the main character, "I'll grant you three wishes."
Thinking it's ridiculous, the main character ignores him, but then her first wish comes true anyway, almost against her will...
After that, there's a junior at work who suddenly turned cold toward her.
Plus that same shady guy who calls himself a demon.
Which hand will she take?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10733]freem[/url]]
translation:
一天，就在圣诞节前夕……
一个行踪可疑的男人突然出现，对主角说：“我可以实现你三个愿望。”
主角觉得这荒唐可笑，没把他放在心上，可第一个愿望竟然在几乎违背她意愿的情况下实现了……
后来，职场上的一位后辈突然对她冷淡起来。
还有那个自称恶魔、行踪可疑的男人。
她会牵起谁的手？

[译自：[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10733]freem[/url]]
